concepts.name: Undead Mage 1 — Rime Seer
concepts.description: Tall skeletal staff caster with a ragged hood.
concepts.prompt: Use case stylized-concept. Create ONE original full-body Runelord undead character concept. Supplied 3 images are the user's approved style and palette references: Bone Thrall (skeletal material), Frost Thrall (dead flesh and ice), Risen Legionnaire (armor and cloth). Match their serious gritty 2D cel-shaded game illustration language and detail scale: broad flat color shapes, crisp graphic contours, hard-edged shadow regions, stylized weighty forms, purposeful threatening expression. Cold silver and slate steel, deep saturated blue-teal cloth, ashen ivory bone, blue-grey dead flesh, tightly controlled icy cyan magic. Damage through a few big chips, tears, cracks and seams, not fine grunge. No orange rust, red or green magic, gold decoration, purple accents, cute baby-face, photorealism, painterly gradients, 3D/PBR or cinematic lighting. Genuine transparent background, no backdrop, ground disc, scenery, cast shadow, labels or text. Single isolated character, complete body and every weapon/appendage INSIDE frame with at least 8 percent empty padding on ALL sides. Neutral combat-ready shallow three-quarter view facing RIGHT. At least 1024px long edge. This is a distinct concept, not a collage or repeat of reference characters. An ancient skeletal Rime Seer, tall lean bent silhouette. Long severe skull partly hidden under deep teal hood; narrow cold eye-light and no smile. Layered ankle-length torn blue-teal robes over a sparse ribcage, small chipped silver shoulder clasps, frayed sash, frost sealing several cracked ribs. Right hand grips a long gnarled black staff with a single angular silver crescent cage containing an icy rune shard; left skeletal hand held forward in a precise casting gesture with one tiny cyan sigil. Thin bony feet below robe; distinct from armored warriors. Staff contained well inside canvas, restrained magic, no swirling scene effects.
